title: Salvation has three tenses (with Genesis 6:16, the ark's door)
summary: Genesis 6:16 with the door line enlarged, followed by 'Salvation has three tenses': we have been saved from the penalty of sin, we are being saved from the power of sin, and we will be saved from the presence of sin.

text.text: 16 “You shall make a window for the ark, and finish it to a cubit from the top; and set the door of the ark in the side of it; you shall make it with lower, second, and third decks.
We have been saved from the penalty of sin.
We are being saved from the power of sin.
We will be saved from the presence of sin.

numbers.note: three tenses of salvation (past, present, future); three decks of the ark
